integrity: Finite exclusions proved by exhaustive reduced integer-domain enumeration with a standalone standard-library script; higher-order classifications proved by Venn-region identities.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite uniform two-survivor model with nondegenerate extinction events; no finite-sample field inference, other quotas or heterogeneous partner losses. Bibliographic equivalence under hypergeometric independence terminology remains possible.
title: Nine pollinators are sharp for hidden three-plant coextinction dependence under two survivors
